name: the-verifier-set
purpose: Answers questions about documents in a browser tab with a small AI model, and labels how true each answer is. A cited figure must be in the document word for word, a rule written as a formula must pass its tests, a claim is decided by an exact solver, and each step is checked by exact arithmetic. Where a figure is missing or stated two ways, it gives no answer and says why.

lane.accepts: a document, something it states once with one figure (the unit price), and a quote offered as stating it
lane.refuses: a figure the document does not state, states two ways, or that is asked for in words the document does not use

interface.in: {"document":"The unit price is 126 pounds.\nThe order size is 12 crates.","cell":"the unit price","reply":"The unit price is 126 pounds."}
interface.out: verified when the quote is in the document letter for letter, in the line that states the cell, with its one figure; unverified when it is not; refused when the document cannot give the figure

judge.what: a quote cites a figure only when it is the document's own words, begun and ended at the edge of a word or number, in the line that is about what was asked

The order size is 12 crates.
